items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I did. Yeah. ... We worked there for it out. Who else played in that group? Florida Al, Alex Scott, Morris Adams.

ctx.x: One job. One job. That's all. One job. He's a good musician. I'm telling you. Yeah.
I remember we played a job at a private party once with Father Al, and you said that you played with him once. You used to play with Father Al, is that right?

I did. Yeah. Somewhere in Washington or something? Magazine, Jackson Avenue. And then we went to a club on Magazine between six and seven. You surprised why I used to own that club, Beckham. We worked there for it out. Who else played in that group? Florida Al, Alex Scott, Morris Adams. We didn't have no drummer. We didn't use no drummer. We didn't have no drummer at the other club on Jackson Avenue.
